text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

July 29, 2020 Councillor Fletcher, during the afternoon session of the meeting, advised Members of Council that, further to Councillor Colle's Member Motion MM23.31, which referenced a noose being found at an Eglinton Crosstown construction site, a person has been found responsible, fired from their job and disengaged from their union, and it was unclear whether hate crime charges would be laid in the incident.
